title: IE40012: Analytical Instrumentation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Statistical interpretation of measurement data; Gas analysis: Gas
Chromatograph, Thermal conductivity method, heat of reaction method, Estimation
of oxygen, hydrogen, methane, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide etc. in gas
mixtures; Measurement of Quality of Air and Water; Nucleonic Instrumentation;
Ultrasonic techniques; Mass Spectrometer, IR and UV spectroscopy, X-ray
Spectroscopy; NMR, ESCA techniques.
